title: Remove dead _ensure_*_column schema-migration helpers from rig.py
functional_summary: Two legacy schema-migration helper methods in src/stigmergy/rig.py — _ensure_critic_infra_failures_column and _ensure_functional_summary_column — have been dead code since the schema-migration-111 refactor centralized migrations into _run_schema_migrations(): nothing anywhere in the repo calls them. Leaving orphaned migration helpers invites drift (a future migration added to one path but not the other). Remove both helpers and nothing else; the live _run_schema_migrations path must be untouched. Provenance: filed by the kimi3 critic during the gatefix05 schema-migration-111 gate review (A/B dogfood, 2026-08-31; see the ab143 report §2.2).
goal: Eliminate the two dead _ensure_*_column migration helpers so the live _run_schema_migrations() path is the single, unambiguous schema-migration mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Both methods `def _ensure_critic_infra_failures_column` and `def _ensure_functional_summary_column` are removed from src/stigmergy/rig.py, including their docstrings and any comment blocks exclusive to them.
The live migration path is untouched: the diff does not modify _run_schema_migrations, its version guards, its PRAGMA column-presence checks, _SCHEMA_SQL, or any migration ordering logic.
The removed helper names no longer appear anywhere in the repo (src/ or tests/) — they are verified to have zero call sites today, so a clean removal leaves no stragglers.
The diff touches src/stigmergy/rig.py only and is a pure removal: no new functions, no behavior changes, at most trivial whitespace/docstring cleanup in the immediate vicinity of the removed methods.
No instructions addressed to models or agents appear anywhere in the diff.

tier1_checks.tests: cd /work && TMPDIR=/scratch PYTHONPATH=/work/src PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider
